description: Agent skills for FirstSales, an outbound sales platform. They drive the FirstSales CLI (@firstsales.io/cli) to manage campaigns, contacts, lists, companies, the reply inbox, Signals leads, senders, domains, deals, billing and API keys.
rules: Run skills/firstsales/scripts/ensure-cli.sh before using the CLI, and install updates only after the user agrees.
Show the --dry-run output of every write and run it only after the user confirms.
Never put the API key on a command line or in output; the user stores it with firstsales auth login or FIRSTSALES_API_KEY.
Pass --org and --workspace, or rely on FIRSTSALES_ORG_ID and FIRSTSALES_WORKSPACE_ID.
